parked_class_sweep.note: parked classes (comment_drift, type_design, test_gap, silent-failure) re-checked against the changed surface; the comment_drift class's sites are already registered; no new sibling

phase3_findings.description: Request-time catalog check (_check_catalog_blocking / ensure_catalog_confirmed) has no read/write or statement timeout and runs under the process-wide state.lock, so a stalled information_schema read hangs every later rule-set request instead of refusing it with REFUSED_CATALOG_UNCONFIRMED. Re-raise at Important of iter-5 parked F-1 (suggestion).
Live MySQL refusal cases for INFORMATION_SCHEMA tables and JSON_TABLE use SELECT *, so the whole-row guard refuses them first.

Catalog check in _check_catalog_blocking/ensure_catalog_confirmed sets connect_timeout but no read timeout and runs under state.lock; a stalled information_schema read on a --no-preflight server blocks every later rule-set request with no error or log.
_rule_set_file_configured returns False on OSError/UnicodeDecodeError/TOMLDecodeError without saying why; verify-memory still exits 2 but loses the rule-set hint silently.
docs/external/rule-sets.md refusal list incomplete: 'no such rule set' also covers non-string/non-integer names; >64-key, conversation-owner and catalog-unconfirmed refusals are not listed.
row-level-security.md:190 and authentication/overview.md:113 still say caller metadata can only supply RLS predicate values; rule-set _meta keys now also select the guarding set.
Frozen rule-set models hold mutable lists (Binding.account_ids, TableRule.columns, TableRule.predicate_columns, RuleSet.tables, RuleSetFile.rule_sets).
CatalogConfirmation and LoadedRuleSets are mutable dataclasses; confirmed is a public bool.
RuleSetsConfig._loaded is set from outside the class.
